reason: Paying nothing until I'm happy takes the money risk away, fair play, but I'd still be the first client of a firm in Kuwait with no reviews, and I always get three local quotes and go for the middle one. They'd maybe be one of my three, but a firm nobody in my Facebook group has used isn't the one I'd pick.
objection: They're in Kuwait, not Manchester. Once the site's live and paid for, who do I ring when it breaks on a Saturday, and will they still be around in a year?
would_change_my_mind: A couple of Manchester businesses I can actually ring or see recommended in my local group, plus a written promise of who fixes things and how fast after launch, with a small monthly support price stated up front.
